content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text resolves a chain collision by qualifying one pressed verse with its immediate neighboring verse rather than weighing chain against chain by footing.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "Mary's phrase \"thy father\" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to \"my Father's business.\"", "rule_words": "the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "\"never verse by verse\": (1) forbids resolving a chain collision by one verse's immediate qualification of another; (2) forbids only the retired stating-verse test, not ordinary contextual interpretation.", "why": "The judge resolves the link by contrasting Luke 2:48's phrase with Luke 2:49 instead of weighing the competing chains by footing, so it does the verse-by-verse move K-C forbids."}
